Name  : Pallavi Takkalapally 

E-mail : pallavirao.t@gmail.com				 Contact : 7794076435

Having  7.6 years of experience in development and implementation of software applications using Java/J2EE   technologies and in all phases of Software Development Life Cycle.

Strong expertise in Microservices Architecture, ActiveMQ Message Broker, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event-driven communication between distributed systems.

Extensive development experience with Java, Web Object, Rest-Full Web Services,  JSON, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Struts2,Microservices,Google Cloud Document AI, JSP, JDBC,  CSS,  Java Script, XML, HTML.

Strong exposure in MVC Architecture using  Spring , Spring Boot,Struts2 framework including Tiles.

TEHNICAL SKILLS:

Programming Languages J2SE, J2EE , JavaScript, SQL J2SE Technologies Java 8, Collections, Threads, I/O, Java Beans, and JDBC J2EE Technologies Servlets, JSP Web technologies HTML, XML, REST Scripting Languages JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, Maven, JSON Application Servers BEA Web logic 11g Web Servers Apache Tomcat 7.0 and 8.x Framework Struts 2.x, Hibernate , Spring, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, WebObjects, MicroServices, Google Cloud Document AI,AWS S3,ActiveMQ Databases My SQL  and PostgreSQL Development Tools Eclipse, My Eclipse .IntelliJ Idea Operating Systems Windows 2000/XP/NT/7/10, and Linux Source Code Control GIT,CVS .

Education: 

Master of Computer Applications from Osmania University, Telangana, India.      

Professional Experience : 

Consultant – ADP, Hyderabad.

Duration:  14th August 2024 – 21st  March 2025

Project Name               :  ADP Payroll – Tax Dashboard Module

Client		              :  ADP (Automatic Data Processing)



Reason for Leaving    : Took a planned leave for medical treatment and recovery, now fully recovered and seeking new opportunities.

Technologies	: Java8, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, PostgreSQL,AWS S3, Kafka,Angular/React , Git, Confluence,Jenkins, JIRA

Description:

Worked on the Tax Dashboard module of ADP's payroll system, specifically focusing on the Critical Dates functionality. This feature enables HR and payroll administrators to manage, view, and configure tax filing deadlines—categorized quarter-wise—for multiple jurisdictions. The module was implemented as a Spring Boot-based microservice, which interacted with other services like Payroll and Vantage using REST APIs. Secure file handling for critical date attachments was integrated using AWS S3.

Responsibilities:

Designed and developed the Critical Dates Microservice using Spring Boot, exposing RESTful APIs to create, update, fetch, and delete tax filing dates.

Utilized Java 8 features such as Lambda expressions and Streams API to simplify business logic and improve code readability.

Integrated ActiveMQ Message Broker to asynchronously publish and consume events such as tax filing notifications and compliance alerts across Payroll and Compliance services.

Applied Resilience4j circuit breaker pattern to handle service communication failures gracefully.

Implemented logic to support jurisdiction-specific rules and variations in filing deadlines.

Designed and developed S3 integration for secure file storage of compliance documents.

Collaborated with frontend developers to enable calendar views and filters for critical date visualization.

Performed data validations and exception handling for date range conflicts and regulatory constraints.

Participated in Agile development processes including daily standups, sprint reviews, and code reviews.

Worked closely with QA and business teams to ensure accuracy and usability of the Critical Dates feature.

Key Achievements:

Successfully implemented the Critical Dates functionality with all the api’s to support and integrate the functionality with Payroll, vantage, improving tax compliance tracking and reducing missed filings.

Implemented end-to-end functionality for managing quarter-wise Critical Dates with file handling via S3, enhancing compliance visibility and data accessibility.

Enhanced user experience by enabling proactive deadline monitoring for payroll tax filings.

Developed and deployed Critical Dates as an independent microservice, communicating with Payroll and Compliance modules via REST.

Enabled loose coupling using Eureka for dynamic service registration and discovery.

Integrated Resilience4j circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures during inter-service calls.



Exposed APIs through a common Spring Cloud Gateway, securing endpoints with JWT-based authentication.

Reduced risks of missed tax filings by enabling asynchronous alerts and retries through ActiveMQ .

Software Engineer – Evergent Technologies Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad.

Duration:  7th July 2021 – 31st March 2023.

Role                            	:   Java Developer.

Project Experience & Product Description: 

Video Subscriber Management is a product developed by Evergent,  it is cloud-based, user life-cycle and revenue management platform. It’s the personalized, multi-platform experience for a global organization with the proven back-office efficiency on demand, which helps in rapid revenue growth for the clients. It consists of multiple modules for end-to-end user life-cycle management and billing platform with the modules Account Management, CCB Admin, BackOffice, Billing Management, Tax Management etc.

Client 1:  

Project Name                 :   FOX US.

Environment                 : Java8, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Rest API, GitHub, MySQL.

Client 2:

Project Name                 :   NBA.

Environment	: Java1.8, MultiThreading, Collections, Web Objects, Hibernate5.4, Restful Web Services, JSON, Maven, GitHub, Log4j, My SQL.

 Project Description:

iWantTFC is a platform where OTT services are served to the customers. iWantTFC is using Evergent Services for managing User life Cycle and Entitlements Checks. It is using the Evergent CRM portal for defining SVOD and TVOD products based on market areas and managing Taxes, Invoices, Emails, etc. Here Evergent is also helping by integrating with third parties for payment and promotions.

Responsibilities:

Involve in daily scrum meetings.

Creating, modify and enhance API's as per customer requirement and integration testing and bug fixes.

Carrying out everyday tasks based on customer’s prioritization of work.

Worked on deploying application on various environments like Dev, Stage using Maven .

Utilized Java 8 features such as Lambda expressions and Streams API to simplify business logic and improve code readability.

Refactored legacy code by integrating functional interfaces and the java.time API for modern date handling.

Worked on Hibernate queries to perform database operations.

Worked on Restful Web Services.

Worked on Git Hub tool for code repository.

Worked on Agile development life cycle.

Used JIRA as tracking tool.

Associate Software Engineer – SutiSoft Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad.

Duration:  7th September 2017 – 5th  July 2021.

Project Name                 :  Suti CRM

Role                            	:  Junior Java Developer.

Project Description:	

 SutiCRM is cloud-based customer relationship management software that automates the processes of marketing, sales, support, and contracts from a single multi-sided platform(MSP). This cloud CRM software helps organizations nurture new leads and customers, while maintaining strong relationships with existing ones. This centralized, customizable, and easy-to-use cloud CRM software meets the requirements for businesses of all sizes.

Responsibilities:

Worked on Agile development environment for product development.

Worked on Web interface using JSP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Worked on CVS to push all the code to central repository.

Involved in Unit testing, and Integration Testing.

Worked on Struts2, Spring, Hibernate Integration for application to able to communicate with Database.

Worked on Interceptors to authorize the users in all levels of application usage.

Used BugZilla as bug tracking tool

Career Break: 

Reason:  Took a planned break for medical treatment and recovery. Fully recovered and ready to contribute actively with new opportunity.

Declaration:

I hereby declare that above mentioned information is correct to the best of my knowledge and belief.

Place: Hyderabad								Signature,

										Pallavi T
